verdict_reason: Port move to 8089 and the primaryPreferred read preference are correct and consistent across Dockerfile/compose/README/IT, but the package-key fix silently turns on DEBUG logging by default in deployed environments and springdoc api-docs is left exposed.

todos.issue: Correcting the logger key from the non-existent package 'uk.gov.defra.trade.imports.address.book' to the real 'uk.gov.defra.trade.imports.addressbook' activates a previously-inert DEBUG default, so every deployed environment that does not set LOG_LEVEL now logs the whole application package at DEBUG (root is only ${LOG_LEVEL:info}, and application-integration-test.yml deliberately uses ${LOG_LEVEL:INFO}).
todos.fix: Change the default to ${LOG_LEVEL:INFO} in application.yml; application-local.yml already sets this package to DEBUG for local work, so nothing is lost.

todos.issue: swagger-ui is correctly disabled, but springdoc.api-docs is left at its default (enabled) in every deployed environment; the justifying comment cites the committed contract artifact and OperatorComplianceIT, both of which only read /v3/api-docs at build/test time (OperatorComplianceIT hits http://localhost:{port}/v3/api-docs on a locally booted context), and it cites a 'design §1.6' document that does not exist in the repo.
todos.fix: Add 'api-docs: enabled: false' alongside the swagger-ui key in application.yml and re-enable it in application-local.yml and src/test/resources/application-integration-test.yml, then correct or drop the design-doc citation.
